<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Political polarization:</strong> The BJP and the INDIA bloc are engaged in a heated standoff, with the opposition alleging institutional bias and &quot;vote theft,&quot; while the BJP accuses the Congress of maligning constitutional bodies and orchestrating unrest.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPM1N1UFppY05HUU1MNzFVMEhLUHdCOUhGMlFIbkFwZE1GWWxlN2o3WXN4bmE1azBaSzQ1eGNFTHVIZ3k5eW1PNF9CSVB3ZlNVUmN5dS15OElTaVQwNWFVVjhEQnZvUlFhYzJuc0wtYnhiUXdidGhFSUxodXpadXE4X3g3TnlQby1EMjVPV05VVVNESERXOExmUGloUkVUdV9YVVk5djF0MzEyeFE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Electoral integrity concerns:</strong> Opposition leaders, including CM Revanth Reddy and DMK representatives, have raised alarms over the neutrality of election officials and alleged conspiracies to manipulate Lok Sabha outcomes.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative shifts:</strong> Ahead of the 2027 Punjab Assembly elections, the Aam Aadmi Party suffered a setback as three of its MLAs defected to the BJP.</li>
</ul>
